guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice latency-90 rose from 0.0046 to 0.1474 (z=+620) and latency-50 rose +1187%, while its CPU, memory and socket metrics did not rise and its workload fell 87%, which fits an injected network delay rather than resource exhaustion. checkoutservice logs 136 'failed to send order confirmation ... Unavailable / no healthy upstream' errors, which point to emailservice as the failing callee, and emailservice itself logs a TypeError in add_HealthServicer_to_server.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate and remove the network delay on emailservice (check for injected latency or a network policy and its health-check registration bug), then restart or redeploy the emailservice pod once the cause is confirmed. Do not delete any data.
